revised_prompt:
Create a clean high-resolution publication-quality system architecture diagram on a white background, landscape layout, crisp vector-like boxes, subtle grid alignment, blue and slate palette with amber highlights for human checkpoints, no 3D effects, no decorative art, readable concise English labels.

Title at top: "Research Agent Platform: Capabilities Overview"

Overall structure: a complete capability map with left-to-right flow from user interfaces to orchestration, control, runtime, persistence, intelligence services, and outputs. Use clear arrows and grouped sections. Keep spacing balanced and text large enough to read.

Sections and content:
1) User Interfaces (left side, grouped box):
- Chat UI
- OpenAI-compatible API
- Local Task Dashboard

Arrows from these into the core orchestrator.

2) Core orchestrator (center-left, prominent box):
- ResearchAgentService

3) Control layer (center box):
- Intent Router
- Workflow Registry

Add a short callout near this layer: "workflow-driven".

4) Runtime (center-right box):
- LangGraph StateGraph Runtime

Add a short callout near runtime: "stateful".

5) Persistence layer (bottom-center grouped box):
- State Store
- Persistent Checkpointer
- Artifact Store
- Wiki Memory

Add a short callout near artifact storage: "file-backed artifacts".

6) Intelligence services (top-right grouped box):
- Upstream LLM
- Scholar Search Support
- Image-2 Figure Generator

7) Outputs (far right grouped box):
- research plans
- idea reports
- paper drafts
- figures
- rebuttals
- presentations
- wiki notes

Add a short callout near a human review point in the workflow: "human-in-the-loop" with amber accent.

Arrows / flow:
- User Interfaces -> ResearchAgentService -> Intent Router + Workflow Registry -> LangGraph StateGraph Runtime -> Outputs
- Show links from Runtime and Control layer to Persistence layer, and from Intelligence services to the Runtime/Control layer.
- Emphasize a workflow execution path and storage path.
- Include small directional arrows indicating stored outputs in Artifact Store and Wiki Memory feeding back into the system.

Style details:
- Use a clean modern engineering diagram style, similar to a conference paper figure.
- Blue and slate color palette; amber only for human checkpoints/callouts.
- Thin crisp lines, subtle shadows only if any, no gradients, no icons, no illustration style.
- Ensure all text is sharp and not overcrowded.
original_prompt:
Create a clean high-resolution system architecture diagram for a research agent platform.

Style: publication-quality architecture figure, white background, crisp vector-like boxes, blue and slate palette with amber highlights for human checkpoints, subtle grid alignment, no 3D effects, no decorative art. Landscape layout.

Title: "Research Agent Platform: Capabilities Overview"

Show the complete capability map:
- User interfaces: Chat UI, OpenAI-compatible API, local task dashboard
- Core orchestrator: ResearchAgentService
- Control layer: Intent Router + Workflow Registry
- Runtime: LangGraph StateGraph Runtime
- Persistence: State Store, Persistent Checkpointer, Artifact Store, Wiki Memory
- Intelligence services: Upstream LLM, Scholar Search Support, Image-2 Figure Generator
- Outputs: research plans, idea reports, paper drafts, figures, rebuttals, presentations, wiki notes

Show arrows from user input to routing, then to workflow execution and stored outputs.
Include short callouts for: "workflow-driven", "stateful", "human-in-the-loop", "file-backed artifacts".
All labels in English. Keep text readable and concise.
